# Bad Scopes Examples
# Demonstrates CK3201, CK3202, CK3203 - Scope validation errors

namespace = semantic_bad_scopes

# ERROR CK3201: Invalid scope chain
semantic_bad_scopes.0001 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_scopes.0001.t
	desc = semantic_bad_scopes.0001.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		# ERROR CK3201: title doesn't have a 'spouse' scope
		primary_title = {
			spouse = {
				is_alive = yes
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_scopes.0001.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# ERROR CK3201: Invalid scope chain - wrong scope type
semantic_bad_scopes.0002 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_scopes.0002.t
	desc = semantic_bad_scopes.0002.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		# ERROR CK3201: Characters don't have a 'duchy' scope (titles do)
		duchy = {
			tier = tier_duchy
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_scopes.0002.a
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}

# ERROR CK3201: Invalid multi-level scope chain
semantic_bad_scopes.0003 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_scopes.0003.t
	desc = semantic_bad_scopes.0003.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		# ERROR CK3201: province doesn't have 'liege' (that's a character scope)
		capital_province = {
			liege = {
				is_ruler = yes
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_scopes.0003.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# ERROR CK3202: Undefined saved scope
semantic_bad_scopes.0004 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_scopes.0004.t
	desc = semantic_bad_scopes.0004.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		# Using a scope that was never saved
		scope:my_liege = { # ERROR CK3202: 'my_liege' was never saved
			add_gold = 100
		}

		scope:rival_character = { # ERROR CK3202: 'rival_character' was never saved
			add_prestige = 50
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_scopes.0004.a
		# ERROR CK3202: Undefined saved scope
		scope:undefined_target = {
			add_piety = 25
		}
	}
}

# ERROR CK3202: Typo in saved scope name
semantic_bad_scopes.0005 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_scopes.0005.t
	desc = semantic_bad_scopes.0005.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = actor

		# ERROR CK3202: Typo - saved as 'actor' but using 'acter'
		scope:acter = {
			add_gold = 100
		}

		liege = {
			save_scope_as = my_liege
		}

		# ERROR CK3202: Typo - saved as 'my_liege' but using 'my_leige'
		scope:my_leige = {
			add_prestige = 50
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_scopes.0005.a
		add_gold = 50
	}
}

# ERROR CK3203: Invalid list iteration base
semantic_bad_scopes.0006 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_scopes.0006.t
	desc = semantic_bad_scopes.0006.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		# ERROR CK3203: Title scopes don't have vassals (characters do)
		primary_title = {
			any_vassal = {
				is_adult = yes
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_scopes.0006.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# ERROR CK3203: Invalid list iteration - wrong scope type
semantic_bad_scopes.0007 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_scopes.0007.t
	desc = semantic_bad_scopes.0007.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		# ERROR CK3203: Provinces don't have courtiers (characters do)
		capital_province = {
			every_courtier = {
				add_gold = 10
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_scopes.0007.a
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}

# ERROR CK3203: Invalid iteration on non-list scope
semantic_bad_scopes.0008 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_scopes.0008.t
	desc = semantic_bad_scopes.0008.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		# ERROR CK3203: 'father' is a single character, not a list
		every_father = {
			is_alive = yes
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_scopes.0008.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# ERROR CK3201 + CK3203: Combined scope errors
semantic_bad_scopes.0009 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_scopes.0009.t
	desc = semantic_bad_scopes.0009.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		# ERROR CK3201: Invalid scope chain
		primary_title = {
			capital_county = {
				# ERROR CK3203: Counties don't have children (characters do)
				any_child = {
					is_adult = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_scopes.0009.a
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}

# ERROR CK3201: Character scope used on title
semantic_bad_scopes.0010 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_scopes.0010.t
	desc = semantic_bad_scopes.0010.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		primary_title = {
			# ERROR CK3201: Titles don't have age/traits (characters do)
			age = 30
			has_trait = brave
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_scopes.0010.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# ERROR CK3202: Scope used before being saved
semantic_bad_scopes.0011 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_scopes.0011.t
	desc = semantic_bad_scopes.0011.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		# ERROR CK3202: Using scope before it's saved
		scope:rival = {
			add_opinion = {
				target = root
				modifier = rivalry_opinion
			}
		}

		# Saving it here, but it's too late
		random_courtier = {
			save_scope_as = rival
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_scopes.0011.a
		add_gold = 50
	}
}

# ERROR CK3203: Invalid 'any_' on singular scope
semantic_bad_scopes.0012 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_scopes.0012.t
	desc = semantic_bad_scopes.0012.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		# ERROR CK3203: 'liege' is singular, can't use 'any_'
		any_liege = {
			is_ruler = yes
		}

		# ERROR CK3203: 'spouse' is singular, can't use 'every_'
		every_spouse = {
			is_alive = yes
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_scopes.0012.a
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}
